The issue regarding Pydantic model serialization in JSON responses has been resolved by introducing a serialization helper function, `_serialize_pydantic_model`, in `fastapi/responses.py`. This function checks if the response content has a `model_dump` method (indicating a Pydantic model instance) and calls it to convert the model into a standard Python dictionary before it is passed to the underlying JSON serialization logic in both `UJSONResponse` and `ORJSONResponse`. This ensures consistent and correct serialization behavior when Pydantic v2 models are returned from FastAPI routes.
